The '''Brell Sediment''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], named after [[Lake Brell]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]] and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] maintained [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]] near Lake Brell, and a [[Lake Brell colony|colony]] was built in a bunker on the shores of the Lake.
